svg.title: Illustration of a mid-game of Tabletop Chess on a wooden table
svg.desc: A hand-drawn mockup, not a product screenshot. An Italian Game position: White’s bishop on c4 is lifted, and its legal squares are highlighted, including a capture on f7. The board sits in perspective on a wood table.

g.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Palatino, Georgia, serif
